lines.en: label dormwarsfive10:
scene postcomedytwo1
: Hahah! Touka sure is funny! Isn’t she, guys?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！Touka 真搞笑！是吧，各位？

lines.en: : She, uhh...really laid into you for a second there, Ami.
lines.zh: : 她，呃……刚才对着你猛轰了一阵啊，Ami。

lines.en: : How’d you manage to piss off a rich girl so badly anyway? You have so much practice with Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么把一个富家女得罪成这样的？你跟 Ayane 相处可是练了那么久。

lines.en: : Did you really tell Touka she’s never had to work for anything? That girl’s pretty much always studying something.
lines.zh: : 你真跟 Touka 说她这辈子从没为任何东西努力过？那女孩几乎随时都在学什么东西。

lines.en: : Hell, even being outside of her mansion and conversing with people like us is studying to her.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，就连走出她那栋豪宅、和我们这样的人说话，对她来说都算是在学习。

lines.en: : Oh, so you’re just not rich anymore? Maybe that’s why Ami’s attempt fell flat then.
lines.zh: : 哦，所以你现在不富了？那大概就是 Ami 那招没奏效的原因吧。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo2
: I may have accidentally tried to intimidate her out of spending time with Sensei. I never thought she’d call me out in front of literally everyone, though.
lines.zh: : 我可能不小心试图把她吓走，好让她别再和 Sensei 待在一起。不过我从没想过她会当着所有人的面把我挂出来。

lines.en: : I’m actually kind of impressed. Maybe she’s cooler than I thought?
lines.zh: : 说实话我还挺佩服的。也许她比我想的要酷？

lines.en: : So you’re not going to try and poison her then?
lines.zh: : 所以你不会试着去毒她咯？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo3
: Poison her? Because she made fun of me? People make fun of me all the time and I’ve never poisoned any of them.
lines.zh: : 毒她？就因为她嘲笑了我？大家嘲笑我可天天都有，我也从没毒过谁。

lines.en: : Right...It’s not the “making fun of you” part I’m worried about, though.
lines.zh: : 对……不过我担心的不是「嘲笑你」那部分。

lines.en: : Then what-
lines.zh: : 那是什么——

lines.en: : It’s that stuff she said about Sensei and him apparently seeing her as his mother. That toes too many of your lines for you to just shrug it off and laugh about it.
lines.zh: : 是她说的那些关于 Sensei 的事，以及他显然把她看作母亲。那踩了你太多条线，你不可能就那么耸耸肩、笑一笑过去。

lines.en: : It’s a comedy show, Ayane. None of it’s serious. Like, why do you think everyone still talks to Sensei even after Tsuneyo alluded to him jerking off on Molly’s unconscious body?
lines.zh: : 那是喜剧表演啊，Ayane。没一句是真的。就好比，为什么 Tsuneyo 暗指他在 Molly 失去意识的身体上打飞机之后，大家还照样跟 Sensei 说话？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo4
: Ami! That’s-
lines.zh: : Ami！那可是——

lines.en: : Probably because everyone in this class has already deluded themselves into thinking he can do no wrong and will eventually love them if they try hard enough to make him.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为这个班上的所有人都已经自我催眠，认定他不可能做错事，认定只要她们够努力让他做，他终有一天会爱上她们。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo5
: You’re one to talk.
lines.zh: : 你倒是有资格说这个。

lines.en: : No, I’m different. I fully acknowledge that he’s a terrible person and that I’m an idiot for liking him. I’m just also a bad person, so it makes sense for us to fuck each other.
lines.zh: : 不，我是不一样的。我完全承认他是个糟糕透顶的人，也承认我喜欢他就是个白痴。只不过我也是个坏人，所以我们互相上对方才说得通。

lines.en: : That’s...the whole Molly thing is...there’s a lot we never found out and...don’t understand. That’s different.
lines.zh: : 那个……那整件 Molly 的事是……有很多事我们从来没查清楚，也……不理解。那不一样。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo6
: Are you saying you’d stop loving him if it wasn’t, though?
lines.zh: : 可你的意思是，如果不是那样，你就会停止爱他了吗？

lines.en: : In fact, is there anything Sensei could do to make you or anyone else love him less? Or is it kind of like that aspect of your personalities is already set in stone?
lines.zh: : 事实上，Sensei 有什么事能让你或者任何其他人少爱他一点吗？还是说，你们性格里的那一面早就定型了？

lines.en: : Like me.
lines.zh: : 就像我一样。

lines.en: : Yeah. Like how it is for Maya.
lines.zh: : 对。就像 Maya 那样。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo7
: Don’t look so down, Ayane! I’m not trying to make you feel bad. The whole point of this was to remind you that comedy is comedy.
lines.zh: : 别这么沮丧嘛，Ayane！我不是想让你难受。我这么说的全部用意，是提醒你喜剧就是喜剧。

lines.en: : And that, sometimes, people exaggerate the truth or say things they don’t fully mean in the heat of the moment.
lines.zh: : 而且有时候，人们会夸大事实，或者在情绪上头时说出并非完全出自真心的话。

lines.en: : Like when you threatened to dismember the entire class for getting close to Sensei?
lines.zh: : 就像你威胁要把全班大卸八块、只因为她们靠近了 Sensei 那次？

lines.en: : No, I meant that.
lines.zh: : 不，那次我是认真的。

lines.en: : I just...don’t want you trying to get back at her or anything. Touka’s not the type to want to hurt anyone. And if that’s really the way Sensei sees her-
lines.zh: : 我只是……不想你试着去报复她什么的。Touka 不是那种想伤害别人的类型。而如果 Sensei 真的是那么看她的——

lines.en: : Then she has already hurt him.
lines.zh: : 那她就已经伤害到他了。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo8
: And I’ll act as I see fit in order to protect him from being hurt any more!
lines.zh: : 而我会酌情行动，保护他不再受到更多伤害！

lines.en: : Assuming there’s a speck of truth to it and that it wasn’t all just comedy, of course. But that’s something I can ask my dad about on my own time.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是那里面有一丁点真话，而不全是喜剧效果。不过那是我可以私下问我爸的事。

lines.en: : Until then, Touka can continue to be a rich, father-stealing whore all she wants!
lines.zh: : 在那之前，Touka 尽可以继续当她那个有钱的、抢人爸爸的骚货，随她高兴！

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo9
: Maya! Come to the restroom with me?
lines.zh: : Maya！陪我去趟洗手间好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. There’s no problem with that, right?
lines.zh: : 对。没什么问题吧？

lines.en: : I’ll go with you, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我陪你去，Ami。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo10
: Unless there’s a reason you’re asking Maya and not me.
lines.zh: : 除非你有什么理由要找 Maya 而不是我。

lines.en: : Are you trying to accuse me of something, Ayane?
lines.zh: : 你是在指控我什么吗，Ayane？

lines.en: : I...don’t really know...what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 我……不太清楚……发生了什么。

lines.en: : You’ve just been acting kind of weird lately. And I don’t want you getting overly-emotional over some comedic jabs from Touka that quite obviously-
lines.zh: : 你最近就是有点怪怪的。而且我不想你因为 Touka 几句明显是——的喜剧挖苦就情绪失控。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo11
: Maya, restroom?
lines.zh: : Maya，洗手间？

lines.en: : Okay.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Guys-
lines.zh: : 各位——

lines.en: : Be back in a few, Ayane! Let’s all walk to the hotel together afterwards!
lines.zh: : 一会儿就回来，Ayane！之后我们一起走回酒店吧！

label sanasanasana:
scene postcomedytwo12
: Sana! You finally came to say hi to me! I was worried I looked too young behind the counter and you confused me for a new part-timer.
lines.zh: : Sana！你终于来跟我打招呼了！我还担心我坐在柜台后面看起来太年轻，被你当成新来的兼职了。

lines.en: : You don’t look that young...I was just talking to my friends.
lines.zh: : 你看起来没那么年轻……我刚才只是在跟朋友们说话。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo13
: Who’s...working at the bar right now? Yuki hasn’t come back, has she?
lines.zh: : 现在……吧台是谁在看着？Yuki 还没回来吧？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo14
: No...Yuki has not come back.
lines.zh: : 没……Yuki 还没回来。

lines.en: : So nobody’s there right now. And Haru-chan needed help for your Dorm Wars thing, so I decided to lend a hand here and just close up shop for the weekend.
lines.zh: : 所以现在那儿没人。而 Haru-chan 需要人帮你们弄宿舍战争的事，所以我就决定来这边搭把手，干脆这周末把店关了。

lines.en: : The...whole weekend? So tomorrow-
lines.zh: : 整……整个周末？那明天——

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about coming in. I’m gonna take the night off and watch movies. But if you want to come over and hang out with me-
lines.zh: : 你不用担心要来上班。我打算今晚休息，看几部电影。不过如果你想过来陪我——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo15
: I...have plans tomorrow, so...sorry...
lines.zh: : 我……明天有安排，所以……抱歉……

lines.en: : Oh! Well...that’s fine. Girls will be girls. Just have fun and...be safe, dear.
lines.zh: : 哦！那……没关系。女孩子嘛。玩得开心，还有……注意安全，亲爱的。

lines.en: : I’ll try, but...I do feel bad, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我会的，不过……我确实觉得挺过意不去，妈妈。

lines.en: : About what, Sana?
lines.zh: : 为什么，Sana？

lines.en: : About...not spending much time with you lately.
lines.zh: : 因为……最近没怎么陪你。

lines.en: : I miss you.
lines.zh: : 我想你了。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo16
: You...what?
lines.zh: : 你……什么？

lines.en: : I miss you...and I’m really thankful you’re my mom.
lines.zh: : 我想你了……而且我真的很感激你是我妈妈。

lines.en: : Am I dreaming right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在是在做梦吗？

lines.en: : Is it...that unbelievable to hear me say that?
lines.zh: : 听到我说这个……就那么难以置信吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And I’m not allowed to be this happy, so there is clearly an ulterior motive at play here.
lines.zh: : 是的。而且我不被允许这么开心，所以这背后显然有别的动机。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo17
: Well, there is...something I could use a little help with...but it’s a little embarrassing, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，确实……有件事我想请你帮个小忙……不过有点不好意思，所以……

lines.en: : There’s no need to be embarrassed, dear. Just tell me. I’d do anything for you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 不用不好意思，亲爱的。直说吧。为了你我什么都愿意做，Sana。

lines.en: : You...really mean that, Mom?
lines.zh: : 你……是真心的吗，妈妈？

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : Then...um...
scene postcomedytwo18
: I’ve been struggling with math, so...
lines.zh: : 我数学一直很吃力，所以……

lines.en: : Could you maybe...help me earn a little extra credit tomorrow night? Since you don’t...have anything else to do?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……帮我明天晚上拿点额外的学分？既然你……没别的事要做？

lines.en: : Uh...h...how?
lines.zh: : 呃……怎……怎么帮？

lines.en: : By...convincing Sensei to maybe...bump my grades up a little bit in exchange for...something?
lines.zh: : 就是……说服 Sensei 也许……把我的成绩往上提一点，作为……某种交换？

lines.en: : You’re...okay with that...right? I mean...it shouldn’t be hard for you since...he already talks about you all the time...
lines.zh: : 你……对这件事没意见……对吧？我是说……对你来说应该不难，毕竟……他老是提起你……

lines.en: : And I...know you guys are already...you know...
lines.zh: : 而且我……也知道你们已经……你知道的……

lines.en: : Is that...okay...Mom?...
lines.zh: : 那样……可以吗……妈妈？……

lines.en: : Did he put you up to this?
lines.zh: : 是他让你来这么说的吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? Of course not. He would never...
lines.zh: : Sensei？当然不是。他绝不会……

lines.en: : This is...my idea...and...
lines.zh: : 这是……我自己的主意……而且……

lines.en: : It doesn’t bother me...if it’s you...
lines.zh: : 如果是你的话……我不介意……

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo19
: I’ll...see what I can do. But you should be trying harder in school, Sana. Relying on me to make up for you is-
lines.zh: : 我……会看看能做什么。不过你在学校该更用功才对，Sana。靠我来替你补——

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll try harder. This is just a one-time thing. Sorry, Mom.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我会更努力的。就这一次。对不起，妈妈。

lines.en: : ...It’s okay, baby. Anything I can do to make things easier.
lines.zh: : ……没关系，宝贝。只要能让事情轻松一点，我什么都愿意做。

lines.en: scene black
: That makes me...really happy...
lines.zh: : 那让我……真的很开心……

lines.en: jump dormwarsfivetenend
label dormwarsfivetenend:
scene postcomedytwo20
: Sensei! Now that Imani is no longer paying attention, I am here to confirm that you- Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Sensei！趁 Imani 现在没在看，我来确认一下你——Nodoka。

lines.en: : I — Akira. This — Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我——Akira。这位——Nodoka。

lines.en: : Is she asleep?
lines.zh: : 她睡着了吗？

lines.en: : It appears that way, yes.
lines.zh: : 看起来是的。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize she could do that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她还能做那种事。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo21
: Yeah...she’s been acting kind of weird all day. So I figured I’d just let her rest since it might be the only time this year she actually gets to.
lines.zh: : 是啊……她一整天都有点怪怪的。所以我想干脆让她休息一下，因为这可能就是她今年唯一真正能休息的时间了。

lines.en: : Huh...She’s actually really cute when she’s not making everyone around her feel bad about themselves.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她不让周围每个人对自己感觉糟糕的时候，其实还挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo22
: Anyway! I am here to confirm if you are still-
lines.zh: : 总之！我来这儿是想确认你是否还——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo23
: Hey, homie! I don’t have a phone anymore, so I need to verbally confirm what time we’re meeting up for our date thingy tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄！我没有手机了，所以我得当面确认我们明天那个约会几点碰头。

lines.en: : I appear to be currently useless!
lines.zh: : 看来我现在是没用了！

lines.en: : You mean the date that I am definitely not coming to because all adults are banned from day two of the Dorm Wars this year?
lines.zh: : 你是说那个我绝对不会去的约会，因为今年宿舍战争第二天禁止所有成年人参加？

lines.en: : Imani’s talking to Futaba right now, so you can be honest.
lines.zh: : Imani 正在跟 Futaba 说话，所以你可以说实话。

lines.en: : Then I guess whenever I’m done with Io. She’s first, right?
lines.zh: : 那我想，等我和 Io 那边结束之后随时都行。她是第一个，对吧？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo24
: Correct! And as Io’s attorney, I must first inform you that I-
lines.zh: : 没错！而作为 Io 的代理人，我必须先通知你，我——

lines.en: : What’s up with Nodoka?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 怎么了？

lines.en: : Will go fuck myself, apparently!
lines.zh: : 显然我要去操我自己了！

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo25
: I think she might have grown feelings.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她可能是产生感情了。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize she could do that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她还能做那种事。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo26
: Either way! Whenever you’re done with your totally normal Io date, just come over here.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！等你那场完全正常的 Io 约会结束之后，就过来这边。

lines.en: : I have an appointment in the morning, but I’m picking up a short shift after that while I wait around for you.
lines.zh: : 我早上有个预约，之后还要上一个短班，边等边打发时间。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo27
: Doctor again? Is everything-
lines.zh: : 又是看医生？一切都——

lines.en: : Everything’s fine. No need to worry. Just show up and I’ll handle everything from there.
lines.zh: : 一切都好。不用担心。你出现就行，剩下的我来处理。

lines.en: : Will you take it easy on Io, Rin? She’s never been on a date before, so it’ll be totally unfair if you just get freaky with Sensei and win that way.
lines.zh: : 你能对 Io 手下留情吗，Rin？她从没约会过，所以如果你只是和 Sensei 乱来就赢了，那也太不公平了。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t have to worry about that. I’ve blue-balled this guy more than anyone. Which is probably why I’m currently facing karmic retribution. But that’s another story.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个你不用担心。我给这家伙弄得欲火难熄的次数比谁都多。这大概就是我眼下遭遇现世报的原因。不过那是另一个故事了。

lines.en: : Can I hear it?
lines.zh: : 我能听听吗？

lines.en: : Maybe when you’re older.
lines.zh: : 也许等你再大一点。

lines.en: : I’m literally older than you.
lines.zh: : 我可是字面意义上比你大。

lines.en: scene black
: Well then maybe you should act like it.
lines.zh: : 那你大概就该表现得像个比你大的人。

lines.en: : Defamation! Retract that statement or I’ll sue you and you’ll be forced to hire me to defend you since I’m the only defense counsel in town!
lines.zh: : 诽谤！收回那句话，不然我就起诉你，而你就不得不雇我来为你辩护，因为我是镇上唯一的辩护律师！

lines.en: : Guys, be quiet. You’re going to wake up Nodoka and she’s going to go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 各位，安静点。你们会把 Nodoka 吵醒，她就要变回正常了。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
Everything was going well and normal and fine and good except for the fact that it wasn’t.
lines.zh: 一切都很顺利、很正常、很好、很不错——除了它一点都不是。

lines.en: Because just several blocks away from a room where everyone was laughing and drinking coffee and wanting to fuck some dude, there was a girl who wasn’t doing any of that.
lines.zh: 因为就在离一个所有人都在笑着、喝着咖啡、想操某个男人的房间几个街区之外，有个女孩一样都没在做。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo28
Isn’t that right, Yumi? You don’t want Akira to fuck your brains out. You’re too busy being upset about your dying mom or whatever.
lines.zh: 是吧，Yumi？你才不想让 Akira 把你脑子操出来呢。你忙着为你那个快死的妈妈什么的伤心呢。

lines.en: : I don’t give a shit about her. Never have, never will. Bitch was probably planning on dying without giving me a heads up anyway.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不在乎她。从来没有，也永远不会。那婊子大概本来就打算死都不跟我打声招呼。

lines.en: Cool, yeah. So about all that hot teacher sex you’re going to have-
lines.zh: 酷，是吗。那么关于你即将要有的那些火辣师生性爱——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo29
: Can you please shut the fuck up about that?
lines.zh: : 你能不能他妈的闭嘴别提那个？

lines.en: : It sucks enough having a voice inside of my head that can actually hold a conversation. The last thing I need is it pressuring me to fuck my friend’s boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 光是脑子里有个能真的跟我对话的声音就已经够糟的了。我最不需要的，就是它逼我去操我朋友的男朋友。

lines.en: Right. But she’s not really your friend anymore. And she’d be totally fine with you getting your back blown out so long as it’s because of love or whatever.
lines.zh: 对。可她已经算不上你朋友了。而且只要你是因为爱什么的才被操得腰都直不起来，她绝对无所谓。

lines.en: : I don’t love him...and I definitely don’t want to fuck him.
lines.zh: : 我不爱他……而且我绝对不想操他。

lines.en: I can read your fucking thoughts, idiot. I live inside of your head. I know what you masturbate to.
lines.zh: 我能读你的心思，白痴。我住在你脑子里。我知道你自慰的时候想着什么。

lines.en: : Everybody fucking does that, okay? Fantasy is fantasy. And it might be news to you, but shit that happens inside of a person’s head is normally meant to stay there.
lines.zh: : 所有人都他妈会那样，行吧？幻想就是幻想。而且这对你来说可能是新闻，但一个人脑子里发生的事，本来就是该留在那儿的。

lines.en: Yeah, that is news to me. Most people cave the second they have a chance to blame their actions on someone else. Maybe a cool disembodied voice or something?
lines.zh: 是啊，那对我来说是新闻。大多数人一有机会把自己的行为怪到别人头上，就立刻屈服了。也许是某个很酷的、没有实体的声音什么的？

lines.en: : Most people? So you’re not my own personal demon? You’re out tormenting everyone?
lines.zh: : 大多数人？所以你不是我专属的恶魔？你还在外面折磨所有人？

lines.en: Not everyone. Just the interesting ones. Who have something to offer in exchange for my guidance.
lines.zh: 不是所有人。只有有意思的那些。那些能拿出点东西来交换我指引的人。

lines.en: : Is Chika one of ‘em? You the thing that made her go cock-crazy too?
lines.zh: : Chika 也是其中之一吗？让她变得对鸡巴发疯的也是你？

lines.en: Not...technically? Though maybe inadvertently. But hey! She’s happy now, isn’t she? Or happier than you at least.
lines.zh: 严格来说……不是？虽然也许是间接的。不过嘿！她现在很开心，不是吗？至少比你开心。

lines.en: : Can’t imagine that’s very hard right now.
lines.zh: : 我无法想象那有多难。

lines.en: Yeah. People tend to suffer when they hold themselves back from what they want the most. But there’s a very easy way to change that, Yumi.
lines.zh: 是啊。人一旦压抑自己不去要最想要的东西，往往会受苦。但改变这一点有个非常简单的办法，Yumi。

lines.en: Fuck your teacher! Join the party! Everybody’s doing it! It’s the only way to get rid of me!
lines.zh: 操你的老师！加入派对！大家都在做！这是摆脱我的唯一方式！

lines.en: : Bullshit. You ain’t gonna fuckin’ bail just because I spread my legs for some pervert.
lines.zh: : 放屁。你不会就因为我对某个变态张开腿就他妈的走人。

lines.en: No, probably not. But it would be nice to see that faux-furious facade crumble beneath the weight of a massive, throbbing-
lines.zh: 不，大概不会。不过看着那副假装愤怒的面具在一根巨大、跳动的——重压之下碎掉，会挺不错的。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo30
: For the love of fucking-
lines.zh: : 看在他妈的——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo31
: Oh...Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哦……Yumi。

lines.en: : That’s good. I thought those Yakuza guys were back for a second.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我还以为那帮黑帮的人又回来了。

lines.en: : Yakuza guys?
lines.zh: : 黑帮的人？

lines.en: Don’t talk to her. She’s boring. Plus — she made fun of you that one time when you decided to be vulnerable. Remember? You don’t like her.
lines.zh: 别跟她说话。她很无聊。而且——你那次决定示弱的时候，她还嘲笑过你。记得吗？你不喜欢她。

lines.en: : Yeah, but I don’t like anyone. And she’s better than you, at least.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我谁都不喜欢。而且她至少比你好。

lines.en: Wait. Yumi-
lines.zh: 等等。Yumi——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo32
: The fuck you doing over here? Shouldn’t you be at the cafe with everyone else?
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干嘛？你不该和所有人一起在咖啡馆吗？

lines.en: : Me? Have you missed so much time in school that you’ve forgotten my key defining trait is never wanting to be around any of you?
lines.zh: : 我？你缺课缺了这么久，都忘了我的关键特征就是从来不想跟你们任何人待在一起吗？

lines.en: : Have you forgotten mine is threatening to beat you up and take your lunch money or whatever the fuck people assume I’m gonna do when I approach them?
lines.zh: : 那你忘了我的关键特征是威胁要揍你、抢你的午饭钱，还是别的什么人们以为我靠近他们时要干的事？

lines.en: : Why ain’t you running away? Why don’t you seem scared?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不跑？为什么看起来一点也不怕？

lines.en: : Would it be weird to say I can smell when someone wants to take something from me?
lines.zh: : 说我能闻出谁想从我身上拿走什么，会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: : Little bit, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有一点，嗯。

lines.en: : Okay. I’ll just keep my mouth shut then. And you can do the same. And we can both go back to not liking each other and forget you ever approached me at all.
lines.zh: : 好。那我就闭嘴。你也可以闭嘴。我们就可以继续互相不喜欢，然后忘掉你曾经靠近过我这件事。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo33
: Works for me. Was just thinkin’ I could use some peace and quiet.
lines.zh: : 正合我意。我只是在想我该需要点清静。

lines.en: : So you...decided to walk up to someone else? Would it not have made more sense to just mind your own business and forget you saw me?
lines.zh: : 所以你……决定走上前去找别人？只管自己的事、当你没看见我，不是更说得通吗？

lines.en: : It would, yeah. Not for me, though. Least not anymore. But you’d call me a fuckin’ lunatic if I actually explained any of it. So I second that whole “shut our fuckin’ mouths” thing.
lines.zh: : 是说得通。但对我来说不是。至少现在不是了。不过我要是真解释，你肯定会说我他妈的是个疯子。所以我附议那个「闭上我们的臭嘴」的提议。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo34
: Cool. Though, I still don’t understand why you have to be near me for it.
lines.zh: : 酷。不过我还是不理解，为什么你必须待在我旁边才行。

lines.en: : I guess your presence will deter worse people, though. So it makes sense for me to not ask you to leave so long as you don’t speak to me.
lines.zh: : 我想，你的存在能吓退更糟的人。所以只要你不跟我说话，我不请你离开也是有道理的。

lines.en: : You sure talk a lot for somebody who doesn’t wanna talk.
lines.zh: : 一个不想说话的人，话还真多。

lines.en: : I’m not the only hypocrite here when you’re a self-proclaimed lone wolf who wastes no time at all in approaching one more animal without a pack.
lines.zh: : 我可不是这儿唯一的伪君子，毕竟你是个自称独狼、却毫不迟疑地走向另一只没有群体的动物的人。

lines.en: : The way you word that makes it sound like you’d want to join one when we both know there ain’t a pack who’d wanna take you in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你那个说法听起来像是你想加入一个群体，而我们俩都知道，本来就没有哪个群体愿意收你。

lines.en: : No, I guess there’s not...
lines.zh: : 不，我想是没有……

lines.en: : There are a few other wolves who keep helping me, though. When it would make much more sense to just leave me for dead.
lines.zh: : 不过还有几匹别的狼一直在帮我。尽管把我丢下等死要合理得多。

lines.en: : You talkin’ about your short-stack friend you’ve got a fuckin’ hard-on for again?
lines.zh: : 你又在说你那个小个子朋友了？你对她他妈的硬了吧？

lines.en: : Uta, yes.
lines.zh: : Uta，是的。

lines.en: : And Yuki.
lines.zh: : 还有 Yuki。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo35
: Yuki doesn’t give a shit about-
lines.zh: : Yuki 才不在乎——

lines.en: : She might have saved my life the other day.
lines.zh: : 她前几天可能救了我的命。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo36
: ...What?
: I could just be overreacting — but I’m pretty sure these two Yakuza dudes wanted to take turns raping me behind a rollercoaster.
lines.zh: : 我可能只是反应过度——但我很确定有两个黑帮家伙想在过山车后面轮流强奸我。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo37
: But then Yuki showed up out of nowhere and kicked their asses. And nobody raped me behind a rollercoaster. Which is a good thing.
lines.zh: : 但后来 Yuki 不知从哪儿冒出来，把他们揍了一顿。然后没人在过山车后面强奸我。那是件好事。

lines.en: : ...Yeah. I think “good” might be puttin’ it lightly, though.
lines.zh: : ……是啊。不过我觉得「好」这个字可能说得太轻了。

lines.en: : Did that really happen?
lines.zh: : 那真的发生过吗？

lines.en: : It did. But I haven’t seen her around ever since. And she looked kind of horrible when she did show up, so I’m currently pretty worried about her.
lines.zh: : 发生过。但从那之后我再没见过她。而且她出现的时候样子挺糟的，所以我现在挺担心她。

lines.en: : Can you confirm that she’s still alive?
lines.zh: : 你能确认她还活着吗？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo38
: Think so.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: : For now, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少目前是。

lines.en: : Check back in a week or two and see what I say then.
lines.zh: : 过一两周再来问我，看我那时怎么说。

lines.en: : What’s she on this time?
lines.zh: : 她这次又嗑什么了？

lines.en: : Nothing as far as I know. Doesn’t make much of a difference either way now that she’s got cancer, though.
lines.zh: : 据我所知什么都没嗑。不过现在她得了癌症，反正也没什么区别了。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo39
: She’s...huh?
: Oh. Surprise. Guess you hadn’t heard.
lines.zh: : 哦。惊喜吧。看来你还没听说。

lines.en: : Yuki...has cancer? What kind? Do you know how serious-
lines.zh: : Yuki……得了癌症？哪种？你知道有多严重——

lines.en: : I don’t know shit. And I ain’t in a hurry to find out either. Let her fuckin’ die for all I care. Gives me one less thing to worry about.
lines.zh: : 我他妈什么都不知道。我也不急着去搞清楚。她他妈爱死就死吧，关我屁事。少一件让我操心的事。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo40
: You were right to laugh at me back in her apartment. Fuckin’ dumb that I let myself get wrapped up in any of that emotional bullshit to begin with.
lines.zh: : 你在她公寓里嘲笑我是对的。我从一开始就不该让自己陷进那种情绪化的狗屁里，真是他妈的蠢。

lines.en: : Should’ve kicked her ass the moment she came back into my life. Not doin’ that just set me up for failure in the end.
lines.zh: : 她一回到我生活里我就该揍她一顿。没那么做，到头来只是给自己挖了个失败的坑。

lines.en: : Now all I can do is try and get back to the real me. The one who doesn’t give a shit about anyone but herself. Who can’t get hurt by shit like that.
lines.zh: : 现在我唯一能做的，就是试着找回真正的我。那个除了自己谁都不在乎的我。那个不会被那种破事伤到的我。

lines.en: : You ain’t gonna say shit about how sorry you are or anything like that, are you? Cause it ain’t gonna do anything.
lines.zh: : 你不会要说些你很抱歉之类的话吧？因为那一点用都没有。

lines.en: : I don’t...really know what to say. I’m not sure there are any words for it.
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道该说什么。我不确定有什么话能说。

lines.en: : No, probably not.
lines.zh: : 大概没有。

lines.en: : Which is why I liked your idea — that we just stand here, not sayin’ shit until we’ve each got our fill of self-inflicted loneliness.
lines.zh: : 所以我才喜欢你的主意——我们就站在这儿，什么都不说，直到各自受够了这份自找的孤独。

lines.en: scene black
: Parents fucking suck, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 父母真他妈的烂，是吧？

lines.en: : ...yeah.
: Yeah...they really do.
lines.zh: : 是啊……他们真的烂。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo41
: Touka, sorry to ask this now that everything has blown over — but don’t you think you might have been a little too hard on Ami back there?
lines.zh: : Touka，很抱歉在一切都过去之后才问这个——不过你不觉得你刚才对 Ami 有点太狠了吗？

lines.en: : Not Kirin, though. It’s okay to point out her issues because those are funny.
lines.zh: : 不过 Kirin 没关系。指出她的问题是可以的，因为那些很搞笑。

lines.en: : If it appeared as if I was targeting her directly, I can assure you that is only...partially true.
lines.zh: : 如果看起来我在针对她，我可以向你保证，那只是……部分属实。

lines.en: : It’s just that the act of stand-up comedy is usually based on the real accounts of those performing it.
lines.zh: : 只是单口喜剧这种表演形式，通常建立在表演者的真实经历之上。

lines.en: : And Ami’s existence is comical enough from my perspective to tell jokes about — specifically after she attempts to intimidate me into abandoning Sensei.
lines.zh: : 而从我的视角来看，Ami 的存在本身就足够滑稽到可以拿来开玩笑——特别是在她试图恐吓我放弃 Sensei 之后。

lines.en: : That’s just a thing Ami does, though. She’s not all there. And even if everything you said is true, putting her on blast is, like...kind of mean, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 可那就是 Ami 会做的事啊。她不太正常。而且就算你说的全是真的，公开把她挂出来，也……有点刻薄吧？

lines.en: : I do not think so. But the Emerald Guardian would likely beg to differ as I put her in a similar predicament when it was my turn to be hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我不这么认为。不过翡翠卫士大概会持相反意见，因为轮到我搞笑的时候，我把她也放到了类似的处境里。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo42
: I like Ami a lot. And I’m not just saying that because I am now on the list of people who have kissed her.
lines.zh: : 我很喜欢 Ami。而我这么说，不只是因为我现在已经列在吻过她的人名单上了。

lines.en: : But to mock her openly is to insult the Supreme Overlord’s character as well as he is her official caretaker.
lines.zh: : 但公开嘲弄她，同时也是在侮辱至高霸主的人格，因为他是她的正式监护人。

lines.en: : Well, perhaps he should do a better job? I can’t even fathom how Mother would punish me if I were to abuse my status to bully others into submission.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那他也许该做得更好一点？我甚至无法想象，如果我把自己的地位滥用到霸凌别人屈服，母亲会怎么惩罚我。

lines.en: : That’s like, all you did for the first month you were here.
lines.zh: : 那可是你刚来第一个月的全部所作所为。

lines.en: : Yes. But I have learned and she has not.
lines.zh: : 是的。但我已经吸取教训了，而她没有。

lines.en: : Is it not wrong that we constantly allow her to push us all around because of who she is to our teacher? Should we just submit to whatever she wants whenever she wants it?
lines.zh: : 难道我们因为她是老师的什么人，就一直任由她把大家推来搡去，这不算错吗？难道她想要什么、什么时候想要，我们就该乖乖顺从？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo43
: I don’t believe so.
lines.zh: : 我不认为是这样。

lines.en: : And I fear that merely ignoring her is not conducive to her improving as a person if she is going to try and quarrel with anyone her uncle- sorry, father shows a single iota of interest in.
lines.zh: : 而且我担心，如果她要跟任何一个她叔叔——抱歉，她父亲表现出哪怕一丁点兴趣的人吵架，那么仅仅无视她，并不利于她作为一个人有所长进。

lines.en: : It’s not that I disagree with any of that, Touka. I have just as many reasons to want to knock her down a peg. She’s just...not like us.
lines.zh: : 我不是不同意你说的那些，Touka。我有同样多的理由想挫挫她的锐气。她只是……和我们不一样。

lines.en: : Neither is Touka, though. So maybe it’s good if we let them go at it?
lines.zh: : 可 Touka 也和我们不一样啊。所以也许让她们两个互相对付是件好事？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo44
: Like, maybe it fuels some sort of rivalry that builds up sexual tension between them and they wind up falling in love with each other while I get Sensei?
lines.zh: : 比如，也许这会催生某种竞争，在她们之间积累性张力，然后她们就爱上彼此了，而 Sensei 就归我了？

lines.en: : Ew.
lines.zh: : 恶心。

lines.en: : Unlikely. I have slandered so many people and yet none of them have kissed me.
lines.zh: : 不太可能。我诽谤过那么多人，却没一个吻过我。

lines.en: : Perhaps an...apology would be in order? Even if somewhat...insincere?
lines.zh: : 也许该道个歉？哪怕有几分……言不由衷？

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo45
: I shan’t apologize for speaking my mind. But I am more than willing to have a formal  discussion with Ami if she so pleases.
lines.zh: : 我不会为自己说出心里话而道歉。不过如果 Ami 愿意，我非常乐意与她进行一场正式的对话。

lines.en: scene black
: Until then, I find it best that we remain focused on the task at hand.
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我认为我们最好还是专注于眼前的任务。

lines.en: : That the girls of the second floor walk away from this battle victorious...
lines.zh: : 二楼的姑娘们，从这场战斗中凯旋……

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo46
: Finally, some peace and quiet.
lines.zh: : 总算清静了。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo47
: Aki-kun, Aki-kun, Aki-kun!
lines.zh: : Aki-kun，Aki-kun，Aki-kun！

lines.en: : I never should have opened my mouth.
lines.zh: : 我真不该开口。

lines.en: : This whole Dorm Wars thing sure is fun, isn’t it? Twenty teenagers fighting over control of your dick? That sounds like a dream come true!
lines.zh: : 这个宿舍战争真有意思，是吧？二十个青少年为了争夺你鸡巴的控制权打得不可开交？听起来像是美梦成真啊！

lines.en: : It can be fun when they don’t all want to kill each other. Or when they don’t reveal embarrassing things about me.
lines.zh: : 只要她们不是全都想杀了彼此，或者不抖出我的糗事，就还挺有意思的。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo48
: What — you’re embarrassed that rich girl said you see her as a mother? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么——那个富家女说你把她看作母亲，你就害臊了？为什么？

lines.en: : Probably because the last woman I saw as a mother routinely sucked me off in the backseat of her car before dying in an accident.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我上一个看作母亲的女人，经常在她车后座给我口交，然后在一次事故里死了。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound embarrassing at all. Very sad, yes. But embarrassing? No. And I’m willing to suck you off again right now to prove it.
lines.zh: : 那听起来一点都不害臊啊。很悲伤，是的。但害臊？不。而且我现在就愿意再给你口一次来证明。

lines.en: : That proves literally nothing to no one.
lines.zh: : 那对任何人都证明不了任何事。

lines.en: : We won’t know until we try.
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo49
: Sekai, why are you wearing Nodoka’s clothes? You know I don’t like it when you cosplay as people I actually know.
lines.zh: : Sekai，你为什么穿着 Nodoka 的衣服？你知道我不喜欢你角色扮演成我真正认识的人。

lines.en: : Well it’s only fair, isn’t it? She gets to wear my daughter’s clothes and I get to wear hers. An eye for an eye and all that stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那才公平，不是吗？她可以穿我女儿的衣服，我也可以穿她的。以眼还眼之类的嘛。

lines.en: : Plus, I can just smell that something is going on with her right now. I bet it’s good too. Finding out someone loves you can change your world. Can’t it, Aki-kun?
lines.zh: : 再说，我光是闻就知道她现在有事。我敢打赌还是好事。发现有人爱你，是可以改变你的世界的。是吧，Aki-kun？

lines.en: : Yes, but it’s rarely for the better.
lines.zh: : 是的，但很少是往好的方向改变。

lines.en: : You say that now because you’ve experienced great despair! But if I were still alive-
lines.zh: : 你现在这么说，是因为你经历过巨大的绝望！但如果我还活着——

lines.en: : If you were still alive, you’d still be fucking my brother and I’d be literally nothing because that’s all I ever was when I was with you.
lines.zh: : 如果你还活着，你还是会和我哥上床，而我会什么都不是，因为那是我和你在一起的全部。

lines.en: : And it’s all I am now, too. But at least I can look back on those years after you died and-
lines.zh: : 而我现在也还是什么都不是。但至少我可以回望你死后的那些年，然后——

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo50
: And barely see anything at all because you’ve repressed it.
lines.zh: : 然后几乎什么都看不见，因为你已经把它们压抑掉了。

lines.en: : Face the facts, Aki-kun. If I don’t die, you get to grow up. Into a big strong man who fucks full-grown adult women! What a world that would be, right?
lines.zh: : 面对现实吧，Aki-kun。我不死，你就长不大。长成一个操成年女人的强壮男人！那会是个多美好的世界，对吧？

lines.en: : But instead — you get this.
lines.zh: : 但结果呢——你得到了这个。

lines.en: : You get a world that mirrors who you really are. One where you can’t make a choice because you're scared of what happens if you choose incorrectly.
lines.zh: : 你得到了一个映照出你真实模样的世界。一个你无法做出选择的世界，因为你害怕选错之后会怎么样。

lines.en: : So you stand there and let it swallow you — patiently waiting for someone else to make a decision on your behalf, then doubting them when they do.
lines.zh: : 所以你就站在那儿，任由它把你吞没——耐心等着别人替你做出决定，然后在他们做了之后又怀疑他们。

lines.en: : How can a person like that win at all? No matter what happens, you’re always going to be wondering about how things would be if they played out a little differently.
lines.zh: : 那样的人怎么可能赢？不管发生什么，你永远都会想着，如果事情的发展稍有不同会怎样。

lines.en: : And why are you here, Sekai? Why are you in this world? Because I want you to be?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么在这儿，Sekai？你为什么在这个世界里？因为我希望你在吗？

lines.en: : I like to think my love for you is just so strong that it defies death. Some may call it “haunting,” but I think that sounds a little negative. Don’t you?
lines.zh: : 我愿意相信，我对你的爱强烈到可以超越死亡。有人会管这叫「闹鬼」，但我觉得那听起来有点负面。你说呢？

lines.en: : Besides — it’s not like I only show up for you in the first place! Just ask the ramen girl!
lines.zh: : 再说——我又不是只为你才出现的！去问问那个拉面姑娘啊！

lines.en: : I don’t need to when she already told me about you.
lines.zh: : 我不需要问，她已经跟我提过你了。

lines.en: : Oooooh? And what did she say?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦？她说了什么？

lines.en: : Something I don’t want to repeat.
lines.zh: : 我不想重复的东西。

lines.en: : Because it makes you hard?
lines.zh: : 因为它让你硬了？

lines.en: : Because it makes me sick.
lines.zh: : 因为它让我恶心。

lines.en: : But it would be totally fine if it was you instead, right? You’d sleep like a baby if you got to fuck her first.
lines.zh: : 但如果是你就完全没关系，对吧？你要是先上了她，你会睡得像个婴儿一样香。

lines.en: : You’re not even alive, Sekai!
lines.zh: : 你根本就不是活人，Sekai！

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo51
: Which is why it doesn’t count! And why she’s still a virgin that you get to claim whenever you please. I just gave you both a little push.
lines.zh: : 所以那不算数啊！而她也还是个处女，你随时可以去摘。我只是轻轻推了你们俩一把。

lines.en: : We didn’t need a push...
lines.zh: : 我们不需要推……

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo52
: You sure did, Aki-kun. If I let the two of you just carry on the way you were, it’d take you trillions of years to penetrate her. Now? A year or two at most.
lines.zh: : 你们当然需要，Aki-kun。我要是放任你们俩照原样继续下去，你得花上几万亿年才能进入她。现在呢？最多一两年。

lines.en: : Probably less if you stop being such a pussy about it.
lines.zh: : 如果你别那么怂，说不定还更短。

lines.en: scene postcomedytwo49
: Ooh, I know! Want me to go “haunt” her? It wouldn’t take much convincing at all to get her over here. Her father owes me. I can call in a favor.
lines.zh: : 哦，我知道了！要我去「闹」她吗？把她弄过来根本不用费什么口舌。她父亲欠我人情。我可以去讨。

lines.en: : I want you to leave...that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我要你离开……就这样。

lines.en: : Big day tomorrow, huh? A date with a girl who hates sex and a girl who’s fascinated by it. And that’s not even counting whatever it is my new favorite has in store.
lines.zh: : 明天是大日子吧？和一个讨厌性的女孩、还有一个对性着迷的女孩约会。这还没算我那位新宠准备了什么。

lines.en: : Leave!
lines.zh: : 离开！
